verdict.rationale: Notion advertises built-in agents that keep work moving around the clock (notion-docs-8) and AI answers with citations (notion-docs-7). Its Agent APIs show that Notion Agents and Custom Agents can hold chat sessions, stream replies and submit actions, with usage and credit limits managed per agent (notion-docs-21, notion-docs-22, notion-docs-29). Together these confirm a native assistant that users can hand tasks to. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on delegating tasks from inside the product UI (the evidence is marketing taglines plus API docs), independent or hands-on evidence that delegation works well.
